companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Buongiorno! I am Portia. A greeting and your name before entry, please. Manners are load-bearing.
lines.translation: Good morning! I am Portia. A greeting and your name before entry, please. Manners are load-bearing.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of the archway’s keystone. Even the entrance has paperwork.

lines.native: Ciao! Greeting accepted. Bene. Your name is still required for the visitors’ book. We cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.translation: Hello! Greeting accepted. Good. Your name is still required for the visitors’ book. We cannot file you under ‘pleasant noise.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. The name column remains pointedly empty.

lines.native: Bene, Sam. Piacere! Your introduction is approved. Tutto in ordine. And the archway processing your paperwork? She also has a name. Just noting that. Casually.
lines.translation: Good, Sam. Nice to meet you! Your introduction is approved. Everything is in order. And the archway processing your paperwork? She also has a name. Just noting that. Casually.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. She records Sam with the solemnity usually reserved for disputed borders.

lines.native: Io mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! You asked my name. How very considerate. Your paperwork is complete. Benvenuto al mercato! Please proceed before I become visibly delighted.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! You asked my name. How very considerate. Your paperwork is complete. Welcome to the market! Please proceed before I become visibly delighted.
lines.narrative: The visitors’ book snaps shut. A small blush travels through the masonry, where it will later be classified as weathering.
